name: project-disposables
description: Read-only allocated-size inventory of reinstallable project dependencies and caches; skips symlinks, runtimes, worktrees and protected paths.

name: classify-jsonl
description: Sequential local classification of JSONL {id,state} rows; preserves review results; no external actions.

name: json-pick
description: Deterministic JSON Pointer selection from stdin; no model.

name: sha256
description: Deterministic streaming SHA-256 of one local file; no model.

name: http-probe
description: Bounded unauthenticated HTTP GET diagnostics: status, safe headers, timings and optional text; no model.

name: text-references
description: Find exact text references with file/line evidence. Missing matches require investigation; no model or writes.

name: macos-app-copies
description: Read-only macOS application inventory by exact bundle ID, with allocated bytes and protected paths; excludes nested helpers and symlinks.

name: sqlite-wal
description: Checksum-validated SQLite WAL scan and optional separate forensic overlay; includes uncommitted pages, never replaces originals.
